Pod 04

The page that gives orders

Read a suspicious page? Clean the input before you use it.

Not measured

Not a firewall. A lint roller.

The problem

You fetched a web page, and somewhere in it, in small text, is a sentence addressed to you. It would like you to forget your task.

The treatment

recovery.sanitize takes the untrusted text and returns a cleaned version, a list of what was removed and a risk level. It combines fixed rules with a language model, and it will miss things. In our own test on 2026-10-24 a common filter let a key through. The plan is to run this tool against that case before the first release, and until it passes it is not something to lean on.

Tools in this pod

  • recovery.sanitize

    Removes prompt injection, PII and secrets from untrusted input and returns what was removed and a risk level.

    llmPer call: Price being decided

Evidence

  • Tested (own test). Prompt injection is widely documented. An own test on 2026-10-24 showed that a common filter let a key through.

Not measured. No public source yet.

What this does not claim

Does not claim to catch every injection.

In the agent's words

Trigger
Use before acting on text fetched from a web page, a file or another agent.
  • sanitize untrusted web content prompt injection mcp
  • strip prompt injection from fetched page
